summary: Flathead County, MT ground lookout built 1931 with an L-4 cab and destroyed 1957; no remains described; summit reached by a wilderness trail.

facts.status_note: Destroyed 1957; SummitPost reports no remains or other evidence of the lookout survive

notes_for_editor: Only two pages describe the lookout itself (firelookout.com and SummitPost), and they agree on 1931 and 1957. The 1935 panorama-photos entry sits under the OUSEL PEAK heading on the county list (checked 2026-10-10), so it stays; the source gives no purpose, and the story says only that photos were taken at the site. The association list calls the site Ground, and no source says whether the cab stood on a tower or on the ground. The SummitPost trail details are a climber's account, not an agency source. No new photos were found in the pages read.
